title: Columbo
description:
S2 E5 — Requiem for a Falling Star
The ongoing feud between an out-of-favor Hollywood actress and a gossip columnist results in murder. Guest star: Anne Baxter.

title: Columbo
description:
S2 E6 — A Stitch in Crime
A surgeon kills a nurse who suspects him of intentionally botching the heart surgery of his colleague, a cardiac expert.

title: Columbo
description:
S2 E7 — The Most Dangerous Match
An American chess champion plays a private match with his challenger and kills him because the man is a better player.

title: Columbo
description:
S2 E8 — Double Shock
Twins (Martin Landau in a dual role) kill their wealthy uncle just before his marriage to a younger woman.

title: Columbo
description:
S3 E1 — Lovely but Lethal
A cosmetics manufacturer is suspected of murdering an employee (Martin Sheen) who stole a wrinkle-removing formula.

title: Columbo
description:
S3 E2 — Any Old Port in a Storm
A wine connoisseur kills his playboy brother to prevent his selling the family winery to expiate his latest scandal.

title: Columbo
description:
S3 E3 — Candidate for Crime
A senatorial candidate exploits death threats, fabricated for publicity, to kill his manager.

title: Columbo
description:
S3 E4 — Double Exposure
A motivational researcher blackmails to further his career, kills a man, then frames the victim's wife.

title: Columbo
description:
S3 E5 — Publish or Perish
An enraged publisher hires a gunman to kill an author who intends to sign a contract with a competitor.

title: Columbo
description:
S3 E6 — Mind Over Mayhem
A prodigy and his robot help investigate the murder of a professor who threatened to disgrace a colleague's scientist son.

title: Columbo
description:
S3 E7 — Swan Song
A gospel singer kills his evangelist wife when she denies him more money and threatens blackmail.

title: Columbo
description:
S3 E8 — A Friend in Deed
A man murders his wife and has a friend cover up the act with a burglary, only to have the friend blackmail him into doing the same favor in return.

title: Columbo
description:
S4 E1 — An Exercise in Fatality
Lt. Columbo keeps a close watch on a physical-fitness fanatic suspected of murdering his business partner.

title: Columbo
description:
S4 E3 — By Dawn's Early Light
A military-academy commandant murders to protect his career and prevent his school's conversion to a coed junior college.

title: Columbo
description:
S5 E1 — Forgotten Lady
A retired actress/dancer stages her wealthy husband's suicide after he refuses to finance her Broadway comeback.
